name: UF-style-pixelartredmond
note: pixelartredmond — the PixelArtRedmond LoRA (trigger from the style), 256x256. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-pixelartredmond.  (sample: seed 1500)

form.subject: a (cozy log cabin:1.3) in a (snowy forest at night:1.2), (warm glowing windows:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (cozy log cabin:1.3) in a (snowy forest at night:1.2), (warm glowing windows:1.2)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixelartredmond.safetensors --lora-strength 0.9 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style pixelartredmond,scene --out 256x256 --palette none --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1500
